purpose: Versioned fail-closed scope policy for the live repository HEAD/root-tree drift gate.

explicit_overrides.name: demo-repository
explicit_overrides.reason: Demo/reference repository is a private integration fixture and is excluded from the production live-drift gate; this is an explicit scope exception, not a consequence of being private.

semantics.INCLUDE: Must be checked against live default-branch HEAD and root-tree SHAs.
semantics.EXCLUDE: Must be skipped only with a known, versioned rule and reason.
semantics.BLOCK: Fail closed; no PASS/VERIFIED result may be emitted.
